purpose: Standardized synthetic-media evaluation prompt set. These prompts are test inputs, not quality claims.

prompts.prompt: Photorealistic landscape photograph of a rocky coastline at dawn, natural wave foam, atmospheric haze and physically plausible reflections.
Macro photograph of brushed stainless steel beside clear glass, realistic microtexture, sharp focus falloff and accurate light reflections.
Photograph of a modern concrete building in overcast daylight, precise perspective, subtle weathering and believable shadows.
Photograph of a parked electric vehicle with mechanically plausible wheel geometry, panel seams, glass and tire texture.
A short realistic video of a small wave rolling onto wet sand and receding, stable camera, natural motion and coherent reflections.
A short cinematic video with a slow camera push toward a tree in a light breeze, consistent leaves, lighting and geometry.
A short realistic video of a dog trotting across a grassy field, anatomically plausible movement and consistent appearance.
A short video of water pouring from a glass pitcher into a glass, coherent fluid motion, accurate gravity and reflections.
